name: Ballroom
_notes: Ballroom - an open-roof hexagonal gallery in deathball's flat pit bowl (~165x135m flat at x235-400 z585-720): six 33.5m low walls (y5-8.5) in a hexagon ring (R32, ~55m across) the player can vault, plus invisible ballOnly 'hull' fences continuing each wall to y40 and a ballOnly cap slab at y40 - the player sees open sky and can jet out, balls stay sealed. NO floor slab - the bowl terrain is the floor (the old 70m box floated over dips and read as 'square slab'). ballMix forces variant-0 (smallest, r1.2) even hosted; max12 caps the ambient trickle via spec. balls.zone: spawn inside r18, pursuit aims at the room center, leash 30 snaps tunneled balls back inside the 32m corner (fences cover every face). Spawn eye y8 drops ~1m. Solo entry: OFFLINE > BALLS > BALLROOM, or deep link /?mode=classic&map=ballroom. Classic mode forces variant-0 balls so ballMix is host-only.
